entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A dragon-obsessed planeswalker who steps through a flaming gate at Ugin's grave and arrives in Tarkir's past, grieving Narset and hearing no more of Ugin's whispers.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: The Spirit Dragon whose whispers guided Sarkhan for years and who has gone silent since the gate.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: Sarkhan's friend and kindred spirit who died at the hands of Zurgo before the time jump.

entities.name: Zurgo
entities.description: The Mardu khan whose forces killed Narset.

entities.name: Dragons of Tarkir
entities.description: The antlered dragons of Tarkir's past, a brood of fledglings led by a dominant dragon.

entities.name: Dominant dragon
entities.description: A large, yellow-eyed female dragon who leads the fledglings in their raid on a human encampment.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The plane to whose past, 1,280 years earlier, Sarkhan travels, where dragons still live.

entities.name: Temur tundra
entities.description: The vast snowy Temur tundra where Sarkhan arrives in the past.

entities.name: Eye of Ugin
entities.description: The place on Tarkir from which Sarkhan's staff carries a hedron shard.

entities.name: Hedron shard
entities.description: A shard from the Eye of Ugin set into Sarkhan's staff that glows in the dark.

entities.name: Ugin's grave
entities.description: The resting place of Ugin's bones and the flaming gate that carried Sarkhan back in time.

entities.name: Mardu
entities.description: The clan whose khan Zurgo killed Narset.

events.summary: Sarkhan emerges in darkness on a snowy Temur tundra after passing through the flaming gate, with the gate gone and Ugin's voice silent.
events.quote: But now he was standing still in the darkness in the middle of a vast, snowy Temur tundra.

events.summary: Sarkhan grieves that Narset died and cries out to Ugin, realizing the voice in his head is gone.
events.quote: The ceaseless whispering, the constant flow of Ugin's words in his head—the voice was gone!

events.summary: Sarkhan falls to his knees, begging Ugin to speak, then laughs hysterically at the irony of wanting the whispers back.
A storm of luminous clouds breaks over the tundra and dragons emerge from the tempest, to Sarkhan's amazement.
Sarkhan sees antlered dragons on Tarkir and realizes that the gate has taken him to Tarkir's past, as Narset's scrolls foretold.
events.quote: And it had led him to the past. It had led him here.

events.summary: Sarkhan follows the fledglings' flight across the tundra, believing this to be his path of healing for his plane.
events.quote: This was his path, the path that Ugin had set him on, the path of healing for his plane.

events.summary: A great dominant dragon arrives and leads the fledglings in formation to hunt.
events.quote: She had come to lead them. Now they would hunt.

events.summary: The dragons raid a human encampment in a basin while Sarkhan watches in awe.
events.quote: The brood descended like a barrage of flaming arrows.

events.summary: A fledgling's gaze welcomes Sarkhan to its brood and he begins to transform into a dragon.
events.quote: His transformation began without a conscious thought, without his permission

events.summary: A human warrior woman with a glowing red claw and her sabertooth kill two fledglings, interrupting Sarkhan's transformation.
events.quote: As the fallen dragon turned on her, she cut through its face from eye to jaw.

events.summary: The dominant dragon's fire drives off the warrior and the brood flies away into the night.
events.quote: And with a rush of wings and screeching cries, the brood disappeared into the night.

events.summary: Sarkhan, enraged, is about to attack the warrior but is stopped by a calm memory of how dragons brought balance, and his anger turns to awe at her.
events.quote: She was a survivor—no, a conqueror!—following a battle with dragons.

events.summary: Sarkhan resolves to make sure dragons are waiting for Narset when she lives again on Tarkir, believing the past is gone and this is a new Tarkir.
events.quote: when Narset lived again on Tarkir, there would be dragons waiting for her.

events.summary: Sarkhan embraces the new beginning, calling it his Tarkir.
events.quote: This was a new beginning, a new Tarkir—his Tarkir.

relations.note: Sarkhan's friend and kindred spirit, who died.
relations.quote: he's left behind Narset, his friend and kindred spirit, who perished at the hands of his enemy, Zurgo.

relations.note: Narset died at Zurgo's hands before the time jump.

relations.note: Sarkhan has followed Ugin's whispers for years.
relations.quote: Sarkhan Vol has been following the voice in his head—the whispers of Ugin, the Spirit Dragon—for years now
Her dragons—for they were her dragons; there was no question that they belonged to her

relations.note: The gate stood at Ugin's grave on Tarkir.
relations.quote: a flaming gate at Ugin's grave
